title: Founding proposal debated
documented_fact: The Lords debate records the proposed Gallery's selection principles, concern with authentic portraits, questions of transfer from existing collections and expectation of Commons funding.
why_it_matters: This is contemporaneous evidence of the intended function and selection logic before later professional reinterpretation.
limit_or_continuity: The debate is evidence of proposal and parliamentary reasoning; further founding instruments must be recovered before every proposition is treated as constitutive fact.

title: Modern statutory settlement
documented_fact: The Museums and Galleries Act 1992 provides the modern Board and statutory functions.
why_it_matters: This supplies the legal baseline against which later changes in mission language can be tested.
limit_or_continuity: Contemporary strategies cannot silently redefine statutory duties.

title: Current sponsor framework
documented_fact: The 2026–29 framework sets out present classification, appointments, financial controls and DCMS relationship.
why_it_matters: It shows the current administrative layer and explicitly distinguishes it from legal powers.
